installCommand: node -e "const fs=require('fs');let d=process.cwd();while(!fs.existsSync(d+'/packages/database')){const p=require('path').dirname(d);if(p===d)throw new Error('workspace root not found');d=p}process.chdir(d);require('child_process').execSync('npm install --workspace apps/web --workspace apps/api --workspace packages/database --workspace packages/validation --include-workspace-root',{stdio:'inherit',cwd:d})"
